card.name: Inside numbers in dose and rate figures
card.fires_on: The decimal point, first digit, or space inside a number being written out, mostly dose amounts, ranges and percentages in drug labels. It fires partway through the number, before the rest of the digits.

modes.label: Decimal point in a figure
modes.description: The period between digits in a percentage or dose such as 2.5 mg.

modes.label: Leading digit of a range or dose
modes.description: The first digit of a number in a dose range, often in MBq amounts.

modes.label: Space before a number
modes.description: The space just before a dose number.

card.plain: It marks the middle of a number, like a decimal point or first digit, in doses and percentages.
